sources.title: Part 38 · Fine tuning SpeechT5 Audio Transformers Course
sources.snippet: The dataset For this example we'll take the Dutch (nl) language subset of the VoxPopuli dataset. VoxPopuli is a large-scale multilingual speech corpus consisting of data sourced from 2009-2020 European Parliament event recordings. It contains labelled audio-transcription data for 15 European languages.

sources.title: GitHub - AhmedNabil03/tts-speecht5-finetuning
sources.snippet: This project fine-tunes the SpeechT5 text-to-speech (TTS) model for Dutch using the Facebook VoxPopuli dataset. The process includes dataset preparation, text normalization, speaker embedding extraction, model training, and inference to generate high-quality Dutch speech from text.
